description: This file defines the LeaveTypeService class, which manages leave type data, including fetching eligible leave types for an employee, retrieving leave type details as an array, and normalizing leave type data. It interacts with data access objects, normalization, and internationalization traits.

classes.name: LeaveTypeService
classes.description: Service class for managing leave types, including fetching eligible leave types, retrieving leave type details, and normalization.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the LeaveTypeDao instance.

methods.name: getEligibleLeaveTypesByEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of leave types for an employee, optionally including allocated leaves.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Retrieves leave type details as an array, normalizes data, and appends 'deleted' label if applicable.
